operation_details.item: The user facilitated the operating-model workshop.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Morning! Just got back from the operating-model workshop. Honestly, I ended up throwing out most of the slide deck I'd prepared and just let the conversation go where it needed to.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! That sounds refreshingly un-consulting-like. Did the leadership team actually engage with that approach, or were they expecting the usual polished framework upfront?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: They were a bit restless at first, but once I stopped pushing the 'three pillars' narrative, people started surfacing real operational friction. That's when it got useful.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. So the facilitation guide you put together — did you end up deviating from it a lot, or was it more of a safety net?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I used maybe a third of it. The rest became a safety net, like you said. I think the guide helped me stay calm, but the real value came from listening instead of steering.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. With the leadership team all in the room, I imagine the synthesis report will need to capture some pretty raw themes then. How's that coming along?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It's in progress. I'm deliberately keeping it messy — no forced executive summary yet. We're grouping the raw themes first, then we'll see what actually matters.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I like that. Too many reports get sanitized into generic 'strategic imperatives' that no one recognizes. Do you think the workshop outcomes will shift the operating model significantly?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Definitely. Because I facilitated the operating-model workshop, I got to see where people stopped pretending and started being honest about what's broken. That rarely shows up in the standard diagnostics.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's the kind of insight that actually changes how work gets done. Sounds like a good day despite ditching the script.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I facilitated the operating-model workshop; keep the facilitation guide, attendees, and synthesis report.
